title: Measured large gaps between rune lines
question: Do fixed original-image measurements reproduce the reported 109-pixel large gap, ordinary 73-pixel gaps, and 129-pixel parable exception?
summary: Four frozen image regions reproduce the scale of the claim: LP2-04 has a 109-pixel gap, LP2-35 a 110-pixel gap, LP2-57 a 129-pixel gap, and the LP2-14 comparison has only 73–75-pixel gaps.

scope.representation: Fixed rectangles in four hashed 2400×3600 source JPEGs, measured as wholly blank horizontal pixel rows between runic ink-row bands.
scope.procedure: Declare source-labeled pages and rectangular rune regions, threshold grayscale rows, merge within-line ink bands, count every intervening blank-row run, and repeat at three darkness thresholds. Verify with an independent flat-pixel projection.
scope.parameters: Rectangles in plan.json; five dark pixels to activate a row; at most 14 blank rows joined within a printed line; grayscale cutoffs 100, 160 and 200.
scope.exclusions: Full 16-page source classification, original Canva crop coordinates, punctuation causation, source typesetting software, bitstream or decipherment.

finding: At all three thresholds, LP2-04 has one 109-pixel gap and ten 73–75-pixel gaps; LP2-35 one 110-pixel gap and ten 73–75-pixel gaps; LP2-57 one 129-pixel gap and three 73–74-pixel gaps; and LP2-14 six 73–75-pixel gaps.
limitations: The four image regions are source-guided selections, not a random or whole-book census. The original post's screenshot coordinates are unavailable, so exact agreement with its measurement method cannot be established. Different page layouts prevent a causal conclusion from the spacing alone.
next_steps: Annotate rune-row bounding boxes across all reported big-gap and comparison pages before measuring the punctuation association; preserve exact page and row coordinates and compare within consistent layouts.

review.reviewer: Fixed-region replay and independent flat-pixel projection; source images visually checked

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12 and Pillow 11.3.0; original-images.zip extracted at the repository root. Also run check.py and plot.py --check.

visuals.caption: Each point is a measured clear gap between adjacent ink-row bands in one fixed original-image crop; red marks exceed 100 pixels.

article:
# Measuring the reported large line gaps

A supplied analysis reports **109 blank pixels** in a large gap between rune rows, against **73** in an ordinary gap, with a **129-pixel** exception on the parable page. We measured fixed rune-text regions on two of its listed large-gap pages (LP2-04 and LP2-35), the named exception (LP2-57), and one of its ordinary-gap comparison pages (LP2-14). This is a check of the visible spacing claim, not a whole-book census.

![Gap widths in four fixed page regions; three listed large-gap pages each have one wide gap, while the comparison region does not.](experiments/records/large-gap-pixel-replay/gap-measurements.svg)

The [original LP2-04 image](#/reader/lp2-04) has one **109-pixel** clear gap among eleven measured gaps; the others are **73–75**. [LP2-35](#/reader/lp2-35) has one **110-pixel** gap among eleven, and [LP2-57](#/reader/lp2-57) has the reported **129-pixel** exception among four. The [LP2-14 comparison region](#/reader/lp2-14) has six gaps, all **73–75**. These are counts of wholly blank horizontal pixel rows, not baseline distances. The full [results](experiments/records/large-gap-pixel-replay/results.json) include every ink-row coordinate. Repeating the measurement at grayscale cutoffs 100, 160 and 200 leaves all four gap lists unchanged.

This supports the *existence and scale* of the exceptional spacing on the selected archived images. The one-pixel difference on LP2-35 shows why a single exact width should not be applied to every page. The forum text does not include the original screenshot coordinates, so our rectangles and pixel rule are a declared independent measurement, not a reconstruction of the author's Canva selections.

The reason for the extra space remains open. The selected pages have different content and layouts. This measurement neither verifies the post's full 16-page classification nor shows that punctuation, numbers, a particular font or a cipher caused the gap. It also supplies no bit-reading rule.

Reproduce from the repository root with `python experiments/records/large-gap-pixel-replay/run.py --check`, `python experiments/records/large-gap-pixel-replay/check.py`, and `python experiments/records/large-gap-pixel-replay/plot.py --check`. The second script independently reduces flat pixel rows and compares every box at all three thresholds.
